'''Extraordinary Consul of the Paqwepori''' was the title given to the [[Paqwe]] representative to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. As of [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], the post was held by [[Belezaboth Ourn]], who was stripped of the title when it was revealed that he had been spying for the [[Yevetha]]n [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]], [[Nil Spaar]].
